characteristic_length.source: NASA Orion By the Numbers 2026b and NASA Crew Module reference

collision_model.source: LA-UR-15-22394 via OSTI, citing approximately 3.7e-10 m for air molecules

interpretation_limits: Knudsen number is based on a 5 m whole-body characteristic length.
The hard-sphere collision diameter is a reference approximation rather than a multicomponent collision-integral model.
The classification is a body-scale rarefaction indicator rather than a complete Navier-Stokes breakdown criterion.
Local gradient-length Knudsen numbers are not calculated.
Shock-layer chemical nonequilibrium and DSMC flow solutions are not calculated.
The result does not by itself establish continuum validity for local stagnation-region heating.
